_comment: Maintainer-curated presentation data for the community gallery. Keyed by extension slug (the `id` scripts/build_registry.py derives from the package's magic.json name). Everything here is optional. This file is an INPUT to build_registry.py; community_registry.json is generated OUTPUT and should never be hand-edited.
_thumbnails: By default each extension's thumbnail is a real screenshot of its new-tab page, produced by scripts/generate_thumbnails.sh into web/assets/thumbnails/<slug>.png. Only set art_image below if a screenshot is a poor representation (for example a page that needs interaction to look right); an explicit art_image always wins over the screenshot.

_schema.tags: Filter tags shown in the gallery. Valid: ambient, focus, newtab, tech.
_schema.art_image: OPTIONAL override, relative to web/. Must exist on disk.
_schema.category: OPTIONAL. Primary category shown on the card. Defaults to the first tag.
_schema.pinned: OPTIONAL boolean. If true, pins the extension to the top of the gallery.
_schema.downloads: OPTIONAL integer. Baseline community downloads count.
